decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric program has a dedicated page and is central to the firm's mental health services, so the firm's sunk costs and public commitment make dropping very unlikely.
The carpentry workshop's own page and reliance on established production know-how represent visible commitment that management will likely justify by persisting, keeping the drop probability low.
Being featured on the home page and closely tied to the firm's eldercare strategy signals high public commitment and centrality, so escalation of commitment predicts almost certain continuation.

As a newer service only mentioned on the website, it has less visible commitment and lower sunk costs than the other products, so its drop probability is higher, but the firm is still likely to persist.
